cn_steps: `HAPLib`（HAP Lib）：它是对一个第三方库的 UBT 封装，向引擎暴露该库的功能。位于 `ThirdParty`，构建规则 `ThirdParty/HAPMedia/HAPLib/HAPLib.Build.cs`。描述符未声明依赖。
部署：`HAPLib` 第三方库封装，优先依赖引擎已包好的上层模块。
怎么用：一般不要直接依赖它；优先用引擎里已封装好该库的上层模块。确需使用时把本模块加进 Build.cs，并包含其第三方头文件。
依赖：在 `YourModule.Build.cs` 加入 `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "HAPLib" });`；对外暴露 `HAPLib` 类型用 Public，仅内部调用用 Private，然后 Generate Project Files 并编译。
调用：不要 include 引擎模块头去用它；优先用引擎里封装该库的上层模块，仅必要时包含 ThirdParty 目录下的第三方头文件。
en_steps: `HAPLib` (HAP Lib): it wraps a third-party library and exposes its functionality to the engine. Located under `ThirdParty`; build rule `ThirdParty/HAPMedia/HAPLib/HAPLib.Build.cs`. The descriptor declares no dependencies.
Placement: `HAPLib` is a third-party library wrapper; prefer the engine module that wraps it.
How to use: usually do not depend on it directly; prefer the engine module that already wraps it. If truly needed, add it to Build.cs and include the third-party headers.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "HAPLib" });`. Use Public when exposing `HAPLib` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.

部署：`HardwareSurvey` 运行时模块，可进游戏包；只在真正调用其 API 的模块里声明依赖。

调用：包含其 `Public/` 头文件以使用导出类型；模块由引擎/插件系统自动加载，通常无需手动 `LoadModulePtr`（仅懒加载时才用 `FModuleManager::LoadModuleChecked`）。

Placement: `HardwareSurvey` is a runtime module and can ship; depend on it only where you call its API.
How to use: platform support is pulled in automatically when targeting/packaging for that platform; you rarely depend on it directly — only include it for platform-specific native code.

Depend: in `YourModule.Build.cs` add `PublicDependencyModuleNames.AddRange(new string[] { "HardwareSurvey" });`. Use Public when exposing `HardwareSurvey` types, Private if only calling it; then Generate Project Files and rebuild.
